image.caption: An oil tanker has burst into flames after being struck by a cargo vessel in a British estuary – sparking fears of an environmental disaster. (Picture: Echo Media Group)
Gannets nesting on the east Yorkshire coast (Picture: Getty Images)

Grey seals in Saltfleet, Lincolnshire, are among the species that could be affected if significant amounts of fuel spread into the environment – something that has been avoided so far (Picture: Getty Images)
The birds are also popular in the north with Gannets often found in Scotland too. (Picture: Getty Images)
